rationale_one_line: ctx is a structural idea (walk a 100k-node graph, load a scored minimal subset), so SCHEMATIC puts the graph diagram at the center, and editorial-90s is the only preset clean of the last 14 entries while its bold-launch register fits the anti-bloat thesis.
writing_tone_notes: Build-in-public peer voice. Confident and a little contrarian. The inversion carries the praise. Everyone bolts on more context. Steve scored it instead. Specifics over adjectives. Short declaratives. Contractions where natural.
do_rules: Lead the diagram scene with the graph-to-minimal-subset walk.
Let the numbers (102,928 nodes vs a 12-item bundle) prove the scale.
Frame the novelty as selective context loading, not another catalog.
Keep the close on the inversion, reframed from the fix.
dont_rules: No version numbers anywhere (v1.0.11 is banned in copy).
No phrase repeated across tweet, Why-this-one, and scene copy.
No em dashes, semicolons, question marks, arrows.
